info.title: MiQroKey Gateway — Control Plane API
info.description: 内部凭证治理网关管理面（认证、组织、凭证、配额、MCP、告警）与外部计费查询通道。业务语义事实源见 docs/api-contract.md。

201.description: User created and logged in; body matches /login

200.description: All other sessions of the current user revoked; the calling session stays valid
Logged in; session and CSRF cookies are set

401.description: Invalid credentials, disabled or locked account

201.description: First SYSTEM_ADMIN created; temporary password is shown once

401.description: Invalid bootstrap secret or tenant already bootstrapped

200.description: Current user, role, status and session expiry
CSRF token read from its cookie plus session expiry

csrfToken.description: 写操作需携带会话配套的 CSRF token
csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token

consumerJwt.description: 外部系统 JWT（RS256，sub=消费者名，仅 /api/v1/billing/**）
